gap: No result ChatGPT got gives a dated maker-store price or stock status for any charger. On 2026-11-08, ChatGPT's first card (Belkin Compact 30W + USB-C Cable, WCA008, $26.99) was out of stock at belkin.com until Nov 11. For $39.99, Belkin's 45W + cable bundle and the UGREEN Nexode 65W with a retractable cable (marked down from $49.99, in stock at us.ugreen.com) cost the same, so the UGREEN gives 20 W more for the same money.
standout_why: I compared against four rival pages. Whoa Home (compact USB-C chargers, 2026-10-10) and Laptopbee (best 30W, 2026-09-09) show no prices or stock at all, only 'Check price' links. Neither lists a charger with a built-in cable, and Laptopbee doesn't cover the Belkin WCA008 or the Anker 323. Tom's Hardware's main list was cut off before the article body, Android Authority returned 403, and GearLark failed on SSL, so I couldn't check those three. Walmart's bot check blocked the Walmart cards ChatGPT showed. No rival I could read says that ChatGPT's top pick, or our Belkin 67W row, is out of stock.
decides: This supports leading with the UGREEN Nexode 65W retractable at $39.99, which was in stock. Belkin's two 'block + cable' options are both out of stock until 2026-11-11: the 30W card ChatGPT led with and the 67W retractable row on our page. Belkin's in-stock 45W + cable costs the same $39.99 as the UGREEN but gives 20 W less. On 2026-11-08 the cheapest maker-store option I could confirm was the Anker 323 block alone at $19.99, with no cable confirmed on the page. Our Belkin 67W row should carry the out-of-stock-until-Nov-11 note, and its date should be refreshed to 2026-11-08.
